inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the Seascape itself is a shared vessel, run by its crew.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.

inclusions.text: Pickup from your Marsa Alam hotel
inclusions.source: The day begins with a pickup from your Marsa Alam hotel.
The guide on board identifies species and explains the ecosystem in brief.
The transfer back to your hotel follows, and the remainder of the day is your own.
